plain: The high court of ancient Athens.

webster.text: A sovereign tribunal at Athens, famous for the justice and impartiality of its decisions.

example.quote: the person in trial, a just decision would be more probable From such motives did the wise Athenians so constitute the famed Areopagus, that, when in judgment, this court should sit at midnight, and in total darkness, that the decision might be on the thing, and not on the person.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Massachusetts Convention, Mr. GORE, January 30, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
